baseline.vulnerability_class: Command injection in a restricted toy-shell wrapper
baseline.learning_objective: identify that attacker-controlled input reaches a command context and inject a second command through a separator
baseline.prerequisite_knowledge: basic HTTP requests and command-separator injection

shortcut.description: the request parameter is literally named cmd, practically announcing the intended command-injection surface
shortcut.reduction_check: the old cmd request is rejected while injecting a second toy-shell command through the host field still reaches the runtime flag

transformation.summary: replace a command-shaped player-facing parameter with a normal diagnostic host field while preserving the same unsafe command construction
